definitions.explanation: Leather made from real animal hide, as opposed to synthetic or artificial leather. A standard label found on clothing, shoes, bags, and other leather goods.

examples.japanese: このカバンは{天然皮革|てんねんひかく}{製|せい}です。
examples.english: This bag is made of genuine leather.

examples.japanese: {天然皮革|てんねんひかく}の{靴|くつ}は{手入|てい}れをすれば{長持|ながも}ちする。
examples.english: Natural leather shoes will last a long time if you take care of them.

examples.japanese: {天然皮革|てんねんひかく}は{水|みず}に{弱|よわ}いので、{雨|あめ}の{日|ひ}は{防水|ぼうすい}スプレーを{使|つか}ったほうがいい。
examples.english: Natural leather is vulnerable to water, so you should use a waterproof spray on rainy days.

notes:
Composed of {天然|てんねん} (natural) and {皮革|ひかく} (leather/hide). This is the formal product label term. In casual speech, {本革|ほんかわ} or {本皮|ほんかわ} is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天然皮革|てんねんひかく}{製|せい}: made of natural leather
- {天然皮革|てんねんひかく}の{手入|てい}れ: leather care/maintenance
- {天然皮革|てんねんひかく}{使用|しよう}: uses natural leather

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {本革|ほんかわ}: genuine leather — casual equivalent, much more common in everyday speech
- {合成皮革|ごうせいひかく}: synthetic leather — the formal opposite
- {合皮|ごうひ}: faux leather — casual abbreviation of {合成皮革|ごうせいひかく}
- {人工皮革|じんこうひかく}: artificial leather — another alternative term
